purpose: Compare actual rendered speech before selecting a replacement for the rejected Supertonic3 v2 experiment.

utterances.text: 천천히 가도 괜찮아. 나는 네 옆에 있을게.
와, 도착했다! 여기서 어떤 기억을 만나게 될까?
준비됐어. 출발하기 전에 편하게 확인해 줘.
햇살이 맑은 토요일이야. 작은 조약돌을 주머니에 넣었어.

avoid: rewriting source text to force an emotion

scales.avatarFit: 1=does not fit, 5=fits a tiny translucent keepsake

evaluation.selectionRule: Do not name an overall winner from vendor claims or waveform checks. Reject missing/incorrect words and obvious artifacts; compare naturalness first, then character appeal. User listening remains required.
fairness: Use exactly the same source text per comparison
Preserve original unprocessed output and synthesis configuration
Disclose model, voice, prompt, revision and synthesis time after listening
Do not count different styles of one model as an inter-model comparison
Do not use callback latency as first audible latency

referenceRights: No real person recording supplied; use invented voice design, licensed presets or synthetic model-generated references only.
productBoundary: Audition corpus only. It is not a live navigation instruction or a verified driving evaluation.
